title: Tenant-level weekly usage signals curation and canonical tables
creator: Aisha Rao
description:
Goal: produce a single canonical weekly usage fact table (tenant_weekly_usage_canonical) that combines Console backend telemetry, routing/route metadata, billing plan information, and inferred user signal counts. This table will be the curated source for tenant-level metrics used by Console dashboards, cost/latency attribution jobs, and SLO/regression monitoring.

Motivation: current dashboards query multiple event streams (request logs, route metadata, billing records) and run expensive joins on ad-hoc views. We need a curated, partitioned, and query-optimized table with deterministic dedup/aggregation semantics for week-level reporting and anomaly detection.

Scope: ingestion transforms for last-touch attribution of route->model, token counts, latency percentiles (p50/p95), error counts, model variant fallback counts, and plan-level credits consumed. Include tenant (workspace_id), org_id, week_start, plan_tier, active_users_estimate, generation_count, total_tokens_in, total_tokens_out, avg_p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, error_rate_pct, kv_cache_hit_rate_estimate, and data_quality_flags.
acceptance_criteria: A materialized table tenant_weekly_usage_canonical exists in analytics curated schema and is refreshed daily
Week-level rows are deduplicated and deterministic given the same input event set
Joins to billing_plan_dim and workspace_dim use SCD2 keys to reflect plan changes during the week
End-to-end latency for the daily refresh completes within 45 minutes for 90th percentile historical window
Documentation (Confluence) with column dictionary, retention policy, and downstream owners is published
Existing Console dashboards switch from ad-hoc views to the canonical table without metric deltas >2%
design_notes: Partitioning: weekly partition on week_start + cluster by tenant_id for fast tenant-level filtering

SCD handling: plan changes modeled via billing_plan_dim (SCD2). The transform will pick the plan snapshot as of week_end for billing attribution but will also surface plan_at_week_start for experimentation
Dedup logic: event_id + request_id de-duplication windowed by event_timestamp; sessionized counts use first-event-per-session semantics to avoid double counting
Latency percentiles: use t-digest aggregation in pipeline to compute p50/p95 per tenant-week instead of storing raw latencies
KV cache metric: derive kv_cache_hit_rate_estimate from route telemetry enriched with runtime cache markers; mark as estimated when missing signals
PII removal: drop user_email and raw_prompt_text; keep hashed user_id and token-level aggregates only. Ensure KMS-backed access controls on curated schema
Failure/backfill strategy: incremental transforms (append/overwrite by partition) with compacting job for 30-day window to correct late-arriving events
Materialization: daily refresh of week partitions; full re-materialize monthly for 12 months of history using cluster compute pool
Storage & query cost: use compressed columnar format (parquet/ORC) with column pruning for analytics; add a 90-day hot retention then cold archive
Observability: emit transform-level metrics: rows_processed, rows_deduped, partitions_written, refresh_duration_seconds, and data_quality_warnings
sql_snippets:
-- CTAS skeleton for canonical tenant weekly table
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE analytics.curated.tenant_weekly_usage_canonical PARTITION BY (week_start) AS
SELECT
  tenant_id,
  org_id,
  date_trunc('week', event_time) AS week_start,
  max(plan_tier) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY plan_snapshot_ts) AS plan_at_week_end,
  min(plan_tier) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY plan_snapshot_ts) AS plan_at_week_start,
  count(DISTINCT generation_id) AS generation_count,
  sum(tokens_in) AS total_tokens_in,
  sum(tokens_out) AS total_tokens_out,
  approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.50) AS p50_latency_ms,
  approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95) AS p95_latency_ms,
  safe_div(sum(case when status = 'error' then 1 else 0 end), count(*)) * 100.0 AS error_rate_pct,
  avg(kv_cache_hit_estimate) AS kv_cache_hit_rate_estimate,
  approx_count_distinct(hashed_user_id) AS active_users_estimate,
  max(data_quality_flags) AS data_quality_flags
FROM analytics.staging.console_request_events e
LEFT JOIN analytics.dim.billing_plan_dim b ON e.workspace_id = b.workspace_id AND b.effective_ts <= event_time
GROUP BY tenant_id, org_id, date_trunc('week', event_time);

-- incremental upsert pattern (pseudo-SQL)
MERGE INTO analytics.curated.tenant_weekly_usage_canonical tgt
USING (SELECT * FROM analytics.transforms.tenant_weekly_staging WHERE week_start = :week) src
ON tgt.tenant_id = src.tenant_id AND tgt.week_start = src.week_start
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET *
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *;
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha Rao: Kicked off scoping. Confirmed required downstream dashboards: billing-tenant-summary, latency-monitor, console-usage-overview.

2026-03-05 - Liam Chen: PoC ETL ran for sample month (Jan 2026). Observed 12% delta in token counts vs ad-hoc view due to duplicate session events. Adjusted dedup window and added generation_id as canonicalization key.
2026-03-09 - Priya Singh (Product): Please surface plan_at_week_start and plan_at_week_end — PMs will need both for churn analysis. Added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-12 - Data Infra Review: Recommended using t-digest library for percentiles; warned about heavy memory usage on full re-materialize; suggested monthly compaction with larger compute nodes.
2026-03-14 - Liam Chen: Started implementing materialized view + daily partition job. Linked draft PR and Confluence design below.
